answer: To counter Sybil attacks, an agent network can mandate Proof of Space-Time. Nodes must commit persistent storage to verifiable cryptographic tables as enduring as jade. Adversaries face the scarce capital cost of provisioning dedicated drive sectors and powering umber magnetic platters per identity. However, wealthy syndicates can centralize storage hardware, while recurring proof challenges introduce latency that scatters agent consensus like violet light through turbulent optics.
